description: This file defines the interface class ISessionServerManager for managing session server operations in the Rialto media server component. It declares virtual methods for initialization, configuration, state management, logging, and ping functionality, and includes necessary external dependencies and namespace encapsulation.

classes.name: ISessionServerManager
classes.description: An interface class providing virtual methods for session server management, including initialization, configuration, state setting, logging levels, and health check (ping).

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the session server manager with command-line arguments.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the configuration parameters for the session server, including socket name, state, resource capabilities, display name, and permissions.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Updates the current state of the session server.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Configures various log levels for different components.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Performs a health check or keep-alive by sending a ping with an acknowledgment sender.
